facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He traded the cow. Then the pig. Then the goose. He kept trading.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans traded the cow for a pig on the road. Then someone offered a goose for his pig. He kept trading one thing for another happily. Each trade made him feel like the luckiest person alive. Other people thought he was being foolish. But Hans smiled brighter with every single trade he made.
